title: Stop hook lets a turn end red on 2 of 65 policy-corpus files (AGENTS.md, dev/audit/README.md)
claim: With the policy linter red and the turn's only change one policy-corpus file, the production Stop hook exits 0 (turn ends unrefused) for 2 of the 65 files policy_lint --corpus-filter prints: AGENTS.md and dev/audit/README.md.
mechanism: stop-selfcheck.sh decides whether to run policy_lint by a hand-kept prefix list (POLICY_PREFIXES). It covers the old home of the audit README (tools/audit/) but not its new one (dev/audit/README.md, moved in the reorganisation), and it never listed AGENTS.md, which CLAUDE.md names as binding and policy_lint measures. The hook's own comment says a prefix list that is too narrow is 'the failure that matters'; its self-test pins only the paths it lists.

evidence.unit: corpus files the hook lets through red
evidence.contention_note: box shared with other seats' runs; a count, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: .claude/hooks/stop-selfcheck.sh:POLICY_PREFIXES (touches_policy), driven end to end through the hook's main path in a scratch repo

perturbation.change: POLICY_PREFIXES gains `AGENTS\.md|dev/audit/` (harness --perturb, applied to the copy the scratch repo runs)

metric_definition: Corpus files (policy_lint --corpus-filter) for which the Stop hook exits 0 when that file is the turn's only change and the linter stub exits 1.
phenomenon_property: Every file policy_lint measures as policy is inside the set of paths whose change makes the Stop hook run the linter; the hook's trigger set is derived from, or checked against, the linter's corpus rather than kept by hand.

null_control.value: production-only change rc=0; CLAUDE.md change rc=2
null_control.note: same scratch repo, same red linter stub: the hook refuses a listed path and ignores a non-policy path, so the 2 misses are the prefix list's, not the drive's

reproduction_steps: run the harness: MISSED AGENTS.md, MISSED dev/audit/README.md, RESULT missed=2
proposed_fix_scope: Have stop-selfcheck.sh take its trigger set from `policy_lint.mjs --corpus-filter` (or add a self-test arm asserting every corpus file matches POLICY_PREFIXES); add AGENTS.md and dev/audit/README.md.
